summary: Second review of 1.24.25 sheet editing (SHEET_EDIT, SHEET_FORMAT, SHEET_ROWS, the SHEET hooks) and the POWERW check, by a reviewer that had not seen the code written; all cases new. refs: 153 cases, 153 agree, 0 differ, 0 unverified -- every expected answer is LibreOffice 24.2 headless doing the same copy, insert or delete (edge cases at LibreOffice's own last column XFD and row 1048576, mapped back to Z and 9999). grid: 286 cases replayed in jsdom, 214 agree, 56 differ, 16 unverified (Excel's behaviour from knowledge and Microsoft's documentation; LibreOffice was used only where it behaves as Excel). power: 147 cases, 98 agree, 44 differ, 5 ambiguous. Grid differences by cause: logical-through-if 7, phone-mode-kept-by-other-tools 7, cut-survives-grid-change 5, logicals-counted-in-ranges 5, typed-look-not-kept-on-cell 4, general-keeps-typed-look 3, insert-no-format-from-above 2, ctrl-a-moves-active-cell 2, sort-ignores-punctuation 2, date-format-not-carried 2, ctrl-a-twice-used-range 2, own-copy-matched-by-text 2, lowercase-refs-not-carried 2, cut-not-ended-by-esc 1, cut-not-ended-by-same-entry 1, cut-dest-refs-kept 1, cut-other-sheet 1, sort-ignores-accents 1, decimals-first-section-only 1, ctrl-end 1, freeze-in-undo 1, enter-leaves-range 1, red-format-read-as-date 1, bold-toggle-by-top-left 1. POWERW differences by kind: miss 13, fires with a wrong line 12, misfire on a right formula, wrong line 12, misfire (same number) 7. Most harmful: a pending cut survives an insert, sort, fill, Delete or undo and then moves whatever cell now sits at the old address; on a phone, Select range stays on after Bold, Sort, the format picker, decimals or the rows menu, so the next tap grows the range and a Delete or Fill wipes rows; Ctrl+A makes the region's top-left cell active, so typing overwrites the heading and Sort keys on column A; logical values (=1>0, TRUE typed) are counted by SUM, COUNT and AVERAGE over a range (Excel leaves them out); =IF(..,TRUE,FALSE), IFERROR, CHOOSE and lookups of TRUE show $1.00 or 1 and sort as numbers; the POWERW check fires on right formulas whose POWER is an exponent that happens to take the stated energy and time (10*POWER(10,3) with 10 kJ and 3 s, square and cube laws, POWER(x,1)) and on questions that ask for joules or ohms, and its line drops everything outside POWER (a /2, *0.8, /746, a unit asked in MW or mW) and reads mWh as MWh.
